objective: Create an empty clean plate for the exact 281 by 35 Japanese RPG Compact Info strip. Remove all text, icons, level copy, HP/SP copy, numbers, and meters while preserving its unusually shallow source geometry. This is a background-reconstruction pass, not a redesign.
reference_role: Reference image 1 is the immutable 281 by 35 source crop and defines the exact two-band shell, 16-pixel upper band, 19-pixel lower band, stepped edge, pixel density, palette, and one-pixel rules. Reference image 2 is the current layered runtime and confirms the exact canvas and component positions, but its generic background plate is not authority.
preservation_invariants: Keep an exact 281 by 35 compact strip at the top-left of the output, rendered four times larger as 1124 by 140 pixels.
Keep the source upper band exactly 16 source pixels high and the lower information band from source y=16 through y=34.
Keep the late-1990s Japanese desktop-game raster palette, hard aliased one-pixel rules, shallow stepped left and right ends, and locally continuous blue and off-white surfaces.
Do not reinterpret this as a standard 18-pixel-title window.
canvas: Return exactly 1124 by 512 pixels. The only UI donor occupies x=0..1123 and y=0..139; fill y=140..511 with a flat neutral white review field.
Do not add margin above or beside the donor, neighboring windows, magenta desktop, labels, legends, or a second strip.

regions.name: upper compact band
regions.change: Remove the circular title icon, SakumaRiri name, class/level/experience copy, percentage, and right circular icon. Continue the local pale blue compact surface and its one-pixel rules beneath every removed glyph.

regions.name: lower readout band
regions.change: Remove HP, SP, all numeric values, separators, and currency copy. Reconstruct the uninterrupted off-white source surface and its bottom rule.

style: Exact source-matched Japanese late-1990s desktop RPG raster UI
Hard source-scale pixels, shallow blue-grey chrome, off-white information surface, and no contemporary styling
asset_rules: Exactly one empty 281 by 35 compact background donor at four times source scale.
No semantic foreground or pseudo-text may remain anywhere in the donor.
negative_constraints: No readable text, pseudo-Japanese, Latin letters, numbers, icons, circular badges, HP, SP, meters, currency, magenta, duplicate strip, standard 18-pixel title bar, modern card, rounded contemporary corners, shadow, glass, antialiasing, or global screenshot redraw.
quality_checks: At source scale the upper-to-lower boundary remains at y=16, not y=18.
The top-left donor is exactly 281 by 35 and every removed component reveals a locally continuous background.
No foreground glyph, number, icon, or donor-magenta pixel survives.
